caption: The drawing depicts a decorative carriage or wagon with two large spoked wheels on either side and a long shaft extending from the front, likely for attaching to a horse or team. The body of the carriage is predominantly red with intricate gold scrollwork and motifs, including leaves and shell-like shapes, embellishing the sides. The interior seating consists of three green tiered benches arranged one behind the other. The back panel of the carriage features a small American flag motif with blue and white stars above red and white vertical stripes. The carriage is illustrated against a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects or visible scenery.
title: Bishop Hill: Bandwagon
